description: Once every 3 seconds, increase your Health, Magicka, and Stamina by 2% for 10 seconds for each corpse within 12 meters, up to 10 times. While in combat, if no corpses are nearby, create a corpse.
Reduces the Movement Speed of enemies hit by 30% for 6 seconds.
Creates a rune of power on the ground for 8 seconds which applies the Affix script in an area.
Deals 2980 Magic Damage over 20 seconds to enemies.
Reduces damage taken by 8% for 6 seconds.
Increase damage done of your next direct attack used within 5 seconds by 2000.
